## Standards stack

This repo carries the full denzuko organisation standards scaffold:

- **SLSA Level 3** provenance via `sigstore/cosign` + `oras-project/setup-oras`
- **Generator lint** — every file is generated from `service.lisp` via
  `denzuko/dapla-deploy-generator`; CI re-generates and diffs on every push
- **org.cispec CMDB** identity Labels baked into every container unit
- **BSD 3-Clause** licence throughout
- **Consfigurator** `:local` deploy over rootless Podman quadlets

## BDD workflow

1. Update `service.lisp` spec
2. Run `dapla-deploy-generator generate .` to regenerate all files
3. Run `dapla-deploy-generator lint .` to verify no drift
4. `make clean all install` on the target host
5. `sudo find-dapla-deploy` to provision
6. `sudo find-dapla-deploy e2e` to validate
7. PR → merge → tag (semver)

## Semver rules

- `MAJOR` — public API / interface break only
- `MINOR` — new non-breaking capability
- `PATCH` — everything else; patch freely exceeds 100

## Subcommands

```sh
sudo find-dapla-deploy               # provision via Consfigurator
sudo find-dapla-deploy e2e           # post-deploy FiveAM smoke tests
sudo find-dapla-deploy decommission  # ordered teardown (irreversible past ZFS step)
```

## Do not

- Edit generated files by hand — update `service.lisp` and re-run the generator
- Add Airflow, Celery, Redis, or Nginx
- Hardcode ports — port = service account UID + `*port-base*` (10000)
- Call `service-account-uid` as a `defhost` argument — it runs at macro-expansion
  time before `rootless-service-account` has applied; use `quadlets-written` instead
